title: Potential inhibitors of RPS6KB2 and NRF2 in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过同源建模和分子动力学模拟筛选头颈癌中S6K2和NRF2的小分子抑制剂，属于蛋白-配体互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Among the major altered pathways in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, AKT/mTORC1/S6K and NRF2/KEAP1 pathway are quite significant. The overexpression and overstimulation of proteins from both these pathways makes them the promising candidates in cancer therapeutics. Inhibiting mTOR has been in research from past several decades but the tumour heterogeneity, and upregulation of several compensatory feed-back mechanisms, encourages to explore other downstream targets for inhibiting the pathway. One such downstream effectors of mTOR is S6K2. It is reported to be overexpressed in cancers such as head and neck cancer, breast cancer and prostate cancer. In case of NRF2/KEAP1 pathway, nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NFE2L2 or NRF2) is overexpressed in  approximately 90% of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) cases. It associates with poor survival rate and therapeutic resistance in HNSCC treatment. NRF2 pathway is the primary antioxidant pathway in the cell which also serves pro-tumorigenic functions, such as repression of apoptosis, cell proliferation support and chemoresistance. The aim of this work was to explore S6K2 and NRF2 and identify novel and potential inhibitors against them for treating head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Since the crystal structure of S6K2 was not available at the time of this study, we modelled its structure using homology modelling and performed high throughput screening, molecular dynamics simulations, free energy calculations and protein-ligand interaction studies to identify the inhibitors. We identified natural compounds Crocin and Gypenoside XVII against S6K2 and Chebulinic acid and Sennoside A against NRF2. This study provides a significant in-depth understanding of the two studied pathways and therefore can be used in the development of potential therapeutics against HNSCC.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 在头颈部鳞状细胞癌的主要改变通路中，AKT/mTORC1/S6K 和 NRF2/KEAP1 通路相当重要。这两条通路中蛋白质的过表达和过度刺激使其成为癌症治疗中的有前景的候选靶点。抑制 mTOR 已在过去几十年中受到研究关注，但肿瘤异质性和多种补偿性反馈机制的上调，鼓励探索其他下游靶点以抑制该通路。mTOR 的一个此类下游效应因子是 S6K2。据报道，它在头颈癌、乳腺癌和前列腺癌等癌症中过表达。在 NRF2/KEAP1 通路方面，核因子红细胞2相关因子2（NFE2L2 或 NRF2）在约90%的头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSCC）病例中过表达。它与 HNSCC 治疗中的低生存率和治疗耐药性相关。NRF2 通路是细胞中的主要抗氧化通路，同时也发挥促肿瘤功能，如抑制凋亡、支持细胞增殖和化疗耐药性。本工作的目的是探索 S6K2 和 NRF2，并识别针对它们的新型潜在抑制剂，以治疗头颈部鳞状细胞癌。由于在本研究时 S6K2 的晶体结构尚不可用，我们使用同源建模构建了其结构，并进行了高通量筛选、分子动力学模拟、自由能计算和蛋白质-配体相互作用研究，以识别抑制剂。我们识别出针对 S6K2 的天然化合物 Crocin 和 Gypenoside XVII，以及针对 NRF2 的 Chebulinic acid 和 Sennoside A。本研究对所研究的这两条通路提供了重要的深入理解，因此可用于开发针对 HNSCC 的潜在治疗策略。由 Ramaswamy H. Sarma 通讯。
